name: Hair Off The Dog Styling Boutique
areaText: Natalie's boutique salon is at 35 Harold Street, Wendouree. Appointments only, so please book ahead.
seoTitle: Award-Winning Dog Grooming in Wendouree, Ballarat
metaDesc: Award-winning dog styling in Wendouree, Ballarat. Natalie specialises in double coats and poodle-type coats. Call 0437 561 238.

hero.title: Award-winning grooming, done gently.
hero.lede: Natalie's boutique salon in Wendouree. Known for beautiful finishes on double coats and poodle-type coats, and for dogs who actually enjoy coming back.

images.heroAlt: White poodle puppy sitting on a table
images.aboutAlt: Groomer cuddling a small white dog in a blanket

servicesSub: Every groom is done by Natalie herself, from bath to final scissor work.

services.title: Full styling
services.short: Bath, blow-dry, clip and hand-scissored finish.
services.long: Natalie's signature service: a bath and blow-dry, then a clip and careful hand-scissoring for a polished, balanced finish. Ideal for poodles, oodles and curly crosses.

services.title: Double coat care
services.short: Thorough de-shedding with a neat, natural finish.
services.long: Double coats need the undercoat lifted out properly, not shaved. Natalie de-sheds and brushes out thoroughly, then neatens the outline for a natural, tidy finish.

services.title: Bath & tidy
services.short: Fresh coat plus face, feet and hygiene trim between full grooms.
services.long: A fresh bath and blow-dry with a tidy of the face, feet and hygiene areas to keep your dog looking smart between full styles.

services.title: Nails & extras
services.short: Nail trims, ear cleaning and de-matting.
services.long: Add nails, ears or de-matting to any appointment, or book them on their own.

whyText: Some clients have been bringing their dogs to Natalie for six years. She talks to every dog the whole way through, which is why nervous dogs settle with her.

faq: Yes. The boutique works by appointment so every dog gets Natalie's full attention.
What breeds do you specialise in?
Natalie is especially known for double coats and poodle-type coats, but she grooms all breeds.
How often should my dog be groomed?
Poodle-type coats usually need styling every 4 to 6 weeks; double coats benefit from a de-shed each season.
Monday 9:15am–4pm, Tuesday to Thursday 8:15am–4pm and Friday 8:15am–1pm.
